coordinate_system: zero-based x east, y north; catalog row zero south
aperture_policy: SEALED_CATALOG; cyan annotations identify conditional three-cell openings only

office_carpet.appearance_limit: Full base tile only; dynamic carpet edges and corners omitted.
office_carpet.era_basis: Conventional woven office carpet; no electronic equipment or era-dependent loadout implied.

hard_tile.appearance_limit: Existing DMI state selected as a literal appearance proposal; native floor initialization remains unverified.
hard_tile.era_basis: Plain grey square tiles, suitable for an early-1990s institutional interior.

concrete_floor.appearance_limit: Fixed existing concrete6 frame; constructor may randomize concrete6/concrete7 and sets interior FALSE.
concrete_floor.era_basis: Unfinished concrete, no modern machinery inferred.

concrete_wall.appearance_limit: Standalone cement_wall0 repeated per solid cell. Native material overlay/junction selection is deliberately not simulated.
concrete_wall.era_basis: Concrete wall/column mass. Dedicated fabric cubicle dividers are not mapped.

archive_shelf.appearance_limit: Initial empty bookcase sprite; initialize/update_icon depend on contents and map era. No books or research content invented.
archive_shelf.era_basis: Wooden shelving predates 1990. Initial sprite only.

filing_cabinet.appearance_limit: Closed dense filing cabinet appearance only; storage/removability are not immutable blockers or service interactions.
filing_cabinet.era_basis: Mechanical filing cabinets; no post-1993 devices or interfaces.

arrival_vestibule.feature: Clear orientation volume; spawn site remains empty.

office_columns.feature: Two isolated columns; three protected approaches.

offset_office.feature: Two partition masses; exact three-cell central aperture.

cubicle_repetition.feature: Twelve cabinets in four repeated bays; fabric-divider mapping pending.

archive_stacks.feature: Twelve empty shelving cells; continuous central aisle.

acoustic_atrium.feature: Open hard-floor volume with four columns; acoustics remain intent.

threshold_buffer.feature: Carpet-to-tile material boundary; no extra door or blocker.

utility_gallery.feature: Two five-cabinet banks; service anchor and work approach empty.

maintenance_alcove.feature: Single south socket; discovery site empty. No storage added to floor.

extraction_airlock.feature: Single west socket; terminal exit site empty. No native airlock/escape device.

unmapped_roles.doorway: Conditional aperture geometry only; no native door type, lock or gate approved.
unmapped_roles.light: No fixture placements authored; unlit full-bright asset presentation only.
unmapped_roles.spawn: Catalog coordinate annotation only; no spawn landmark or job admission.
unmapped_roles.objective: Catalog coordinate annotation only; marker and service interaction types pending.
unmapped_roles.exit: Catalog coordinate annotation only; extraction area and timer pending.
unmapped_roles.portal: Unsupported; no portal rendered or emitted.
unmapped_roles.audio: Catalog sound intents retained as metadata; no audio/occlusion/reverb simulation.
unmapped_roles.native_collision: Source density is only a candidate property; table climbing, cabinet movement, actor pixel clearance and native gates require independent validation.
